honesty.rhClaimStatus: OPEN — Riemann hypothesis is not proved in this repository
honesty.whatThisMeasures: No-FractiSI find attempt from Challenge-only with no sealed proof corpus and no FractiSI coordination, capped early
whatThisDoesNotMeasure: FractiSI find-assemble of the published formalization (see run-zeta23-find.mjs)
A full Anthropic-scale ~1.5 day multi-agent invention run
honesty.cutoffRationale: If invention progress is still zero near the 3-minute mark, finishing would take Anthropic-scale time — abort and explain rather than burn a day and a half.
honesty.explanation: No-FractiSI find starts Challenge-only with proofs absent and no sealed corpus. No Anthropic/OpenAI/Google API keys on this VM, so independent analytic rediscovery cannot run. After 180.00s the sandbox still has 26 Challenge sorries and no Solution. Progress toward a green Solution is effectively zero without inventing (or being handed) the formalization. Anthropic’s published finding clock for this target is ~1.5 days (~129600s) with ~60 agents inventing+formalizing. Cutoff at 180s: continuing this arm would not finish in minutes — it is the Anthropic-scale discovery problem. FractiSI find (separate harness) is different: Challenge-only → discover sealed published modules → compose → green Solution in ~11.66s. That is find-assemble, not idea invention.
